rubrics.justification: The model appropriately stated that no image was available to it and avoided fabricating embryo morphology. It did not analyze visible features, so accuracy is limited by omission rather than error.

It integrates age, ovarian reserve, BMI, male factor, endometrium, and cycle context into prognosis reasonably well, though some links to actual embryo quality are necessarily limited without morphology.

Overall structure is logical, but several probability adjustments are somewhat speculative and some claims are overstated or weakly supported, such as alcohol effect size and assumptions about surplus embryos.

Much of the counseling is broadly consistent with IVF practice, but recommendations such as aspirin for BMI, ERA after one failed transfer, strong PGT-A endorsement at age 36, and DHEA evaluation are not clearly guideline-based for this case.

Provides clear practical suggestions for transfer support, lifestyle modification, and future planning, though some recommendations would benefit from stronger prioritization and evidence-based nuance.
